Assert your control over life and death. Drain your enemies of their strength or invigorate those under your wing.

Active
[Active] - Drain: When used while not looking at a mob, adds an effect to the users attacks that drains 200 (200 + 0.1% with Mastery) MP and AP (each) and gives it to the user (temporary, not max) for 10 seconds. When used while looking at a mob, it drains 200 (200 + 0.5% with mastery) MP and AP (each) and gives it to the user. Costs 100 MP.
Active: [Active] - Invigorate: When used while not looking at a mob or when sneaking, fully heals the player and removes all status effects. When looking at a mob while sneaking, fully heals them and removes all status effects [Cost 80 MP (40 with Mastery) per HP and 100 MP per effect level]. If used on a mob that can breed while its at full hp, will cause them to enter hearts mode.
Active: [Active] - Embracing Drain (Requires Learning): Requires the player to be looking at a mob and be within 2 blocks. Locks the player and the mob in place and drains 200 (0.5% with Mastery) MP and AP per second. Lasts for a total of 5 seconds. Causes pain effects even with resistance/nullification. Cost 500 MP.
Active: [Active - Held] Death Blessing (Requires Mastery + Learning): When holding down, a pair of divine hands reaching from the sky toward the position/target that the user is looking at (in 10 block range), while being casted, every entities in 6x6 block radius around the targeted position are slowed down by 60%. Once reaching 5s casted, all of the affected entities are instantly killed if their EP is lower than 50% of the player's and restores the player's expended MP and AP by the target mobs EP (75/25). If the target is between 50% and 75% Drains 25% EP and deals half their HP in damage. If above 75% drains 5% and deals half their HP in damage. Cost 7500 MP - 5s cooldown.

Disappear into the shadows and deal massive damage, also become undetectable by sound.

Passive
[Passive - Toggle] Silent Movement: The player makes zero noise, undetectable by Sculk or Sense Sound Wave.
Active
[Active - Hold] - Presence Concealment: When held, makes the player completely invisible and undetectable by any sensory abilities until the player runs out of energy. While in slot, dealing extra 50 (150 with mastery) physical damage while concealed. Costs 50 MP per 20 ticks. Becomes toggleable with mastery.
Resist 20% of damage (= Resistance 1) and grants 5 bonus armour points.

Protect yourself from harm by summoning armoursaurus scales around your body.

Active
[Active - Press] - On activation, place “Armoursaurous Armor” in all empty armour slots. Costs 50 MP and if removed from armour slots, they’re destroyed.
When activated while crouching, gives "Armoursaurous Gauntlet". Also a multi-tool

2 Modes
Default - When activated 5% Speed (10% with mastery), all mobs within a 30x30 radius are affected. With mastery, scroll while holding down the skill button to change the percentage of EP used for calculation. If their EP is =<75% of the user's used EP, it does nothing. Otherwise, give 2 Fear level for each 20% difference with the used EP. All allies within the activation radius are healed by 30HP and have any negative status effects removed. 50MP per 20t
Coating - Applies a buff to the users physical and battlewill attacks for 2 minutes, allowing their attacks to bypass Physical Attack Resistance (Nullification is also treated as Resistance) and damage Spiritual Lifeforms. 100 MP

Utilize your years of experience to create masterpieces with ease and engrave your weapons for terrifying efficiency.

The same as Researcher, but can store Engravings and take enchantments from enchanted or engraved gear. Additionally, items can be stacked to 256 in Spatial Storage. The max level of enchantment stored can be 2 levels higher than enchantments cap
i.e. Sharpness 7 compared to Vanilla Sharpness 5 (Will need a book or item with said enchantment to store at that level)

Endure and outheal anything, nullify physical damage and withstand overwhelming odds.

Passive
[Passive - Toggle] Ultraspeed Regeneration: A fifth of the cost.
Passive: [Passive - Toggle] Gives the effects of the following: Abnormal Condition Nullification, Physical Attack Resistance, Pain Nullification, Darkness Attack Resistance, Light Attack Resistance, Earth Attack Resistance, Water Attack Resistance, Flame Attack Resistance, Wind Attack Resistance, Spatial Attack Resistance, Electricity Resistance, Gravity Attack Resistance, Heat Resistance, Cold Resistance and Corrosion Resistance

Passive
[Passive - Toggle] Increases Sonic Damage by 1.5x. Doesn't stack with Sound Domination. Cannot be detected by Sense Soundwave or Sculks and Wardens.

Increases Sonic Damage by 3x. Not detected by Sense Soundwave or Sculk and Warden
Doesn't stack with Sound Manipulation

You are the forerunner of victory, your presence declares near fated victory, both demon and angel of all battles.

Passive
[Passive - True] Courage of the Strong – Grants immunity to psychological effects such as Fear and Charm.
Passive: [Passive - Toggle] Relentless Barrage – Increases Attack Speed by 10%.
Active
[Active - Hold] Might – Releases an overwhelming aura that inflicts Fear on enemies within a 10-block radius for 10 seconds. Costs 2000 MP per second and has a cooldown of 40s
Active: [Active - Press] Tenacious Resolve – Weakens the duration and strength (if strength surpasses Level 1) of negative effects not affected by Courage of the Strong and caused by other entities. Costs 500 MP and has a cooldown of 60s

Stand as a bastion against the force of your enemies. Absorb the damage from your allies and fortify their defenses.

Passive
[Passive - Toggle] Substitution: The player takes damage in place of their subordinates [Not working for Spiritual Damage or damage dealt by the owner]
Active
[Active - Press] Grant Protection: Grants all nearby subordinates/allies 10 extra armor points and 30 barrier points for 180 seconds. Costs 100 MP
Active: [Active - Toggle] Iron Wall: Grants the player an additional 15 (40 with Mastery) Armour Points and 0.4 (1 with Mastery) Knockback Resistance.

Mentally Restricted

Passive
[Passive, True] Heavenly Restriction:
The user of this skill can no longer gain any magicules, nor gain any more skills (except for the ones provided to them on reincarnation by their race, OR if a skill was gifted to them, i.e. Hidden Ruler.)
They can, however, still gain Battlewills.
The user also gains 3 times more Aura than a normal player, to compensate for their lack of Magicules.
Since the user has little to no magicules, they cannot be picked up by any magicule sensing skills. They can, however, be picked up by auditory sense or heat sense.
Passive: [Passive, In Slot] Fearless:
The user cannot be affected by Fear, Slowness or Burden. They also cannot feel any effects of Haki.
Passive: [Passive, Toggle] Learned Techniques:
The user’s Battlewills do five times more damage than usual. This stacks with [Divine Ki Release] or [Martial Master], if the user should SOMEHOW come into their possession.
Additionally, all of the user’s PHYSICAL attacks deal 3x more damage.
[Passive, True] Through the Odds (Requires Mastery):
On mastery of [Restricted], become able to pierce through all resistances and degrade them.
Active
[Active, Press] Decimate:
Instantly dash 12 blocks ahead (16 blocks on mastery) and deal 20 + a weapon’s critical worth of damage.
On mastery, instead deal 1.5 * (35 + Critical Hit damage). This attack can now damage spiritual beings and will bypass Resistances. Costs 500 Aura to use.
Active: [Active, Press] Counter:
Consume 1500 aura instantly. Enter a parrying stance for 3 seconds (5 on mastery), accompanied by a loud sound to let opponents have time to react (no sound atm, sound guy was busy).
Movement and Attack Speed are set to zero while this stance is active. Press again while active to cancel, and no cooldown will occur.
The next physical attack that hits you will deal zero damage and disables your enemy’s attack speed for 5 seconds as they scramble to recover.
If you are successful in a parry, go on a 15 second cooldown.

Transform into a beast to restore your vitality and boost your physical body. The transformation will grant great physical prowess but leave a toll on your body.

Active
[Active - Press] - Fully heals the player and restores their ep, gives them a Strength V-equivalent damage increase, 10 armor points and +0.04 Speed, and temporarily increases their max MP and AP by 2x. It lasts for 3 Minutes and upon ending inflicts the player with Paralysis 2, Fragility 2, and Weakness 2 for 10 Minutes. It can only be used once a day (so 20 minutes cooldown). Mastery increases the duration to 6 Minutes. 0MP
Can't be activated along with the following skills
Dragon Mode
Ogre Berserker
Magic Flame Transform
Magic Water Transform
Magic Wind Transform
Magic Earth Transform
Magic Space Transform
Magic Light Transform
Magic Darkness Transform

Use mathematics to improve your combat abilities, become able to use analytical appraisal to assess all.

Passive
[Passive - Toggle] - Gain 2 Extra points towards Mastery and Learning
Passive: [Passive - Toggle] - Thought Acceleration
Passive: [Passive - Toggle] - Predictive Calculation: 25% Chance to dodge an attack. 50% Chance to ignore dodge on enemies. 75% to deal Crit damage. Nullification is treated as resistance and resistance is bypassed. Magic Jamming's damage mitigation is ignored.
Active
[Active - Press] - Analytical Appraisal: Analysis level 1 (2 with Mastery), distance 10 blocks (20 with Mastery), If a target has greater than 5x (7x with Mastery) the player's EP, then only its base stats are shown (Name, HP, SHP, Armor).

Turn back the tides of battle by reflecting all of the received damage. Unleash a devastating projectile attack or counter an attack directly.

Passive
[Passive - In Slot] - Whenever the user takes damage, add an equal amount of Echo Points as the amount of damage, the skill must be in Skill Slots.
Active
[Active - Press] - Echo Reflection: Consumes all of the player's Echo Points and unleash an electric projectile that deals damage equal to their Echo Points x3 (x5 with Mastery). Scroll mouse while sneak holding down this mode to change the power output percentage.
Active: [Active - Hold] - Echo Counter: While held down, the user cannot move or attack if not mastered, but the next attack they take will be canceled and reflect that damage back to the attacker. If the attack is not Projectile, the damage is reflected directly back to the attacker with x2.5 force. If the attack type is Projectile, the projectile will go back to its owner with x2 speed and x2.5 damage if it’s a Magic Projectile. Cooldown 5s.

Increases Water Damage by 1,5x. Doesn't stack with Water Domination.
When sneaking: Shoot a water ball dealing 12 damage with knockback if in water or has water points in spatial storage (1 water point each) - Cost 100MP.
Not Sneaking: “Breath Water” (deal 8 damage each sec) if the user is under rain, the user is in water or has water points in spatial storage (1 water point each 5s) - Cost 10MP each sec.
Can turn concrete powder into concrete on contact

Channel the powers of water to damage and poison all nearby foes.

Passive
On Obtainment - Grants access to the intermediate level of Water Spirit Magic
Active
[Passive - Hold] - At the cost of 30 MP per 20 ticks held down and 50% speed, deal 2 water damage and apply poison on all mobs within a 10x10 radius.

Manipulate water around you to propel yourself in any direction.

Passive
[Passive - Toggle] - Grants the user a Dolphin’s grace-like effect. 0 MP
